args.script:
(() => { const md = document.querySelector('meta[name="description"]'); const can = document.querySelector('link[rel="canonical"]'); let root = document.querySelector('article') || document.querySelector('main') || document.querySelector('[role="main"]') || document.body; const clone = root.cloneNode(true); clone.querySelectorAll('script,style,noscript,template,iframe,svg,canvas,nav,header,footer,aside,form,button,select').forEach(e => e.remove()); let text = (clone.innerText || clone.textContent || '').replace(/[ 	]+/g, ' ').replace(/
\s*
+/g, '

').trim(); const MAX = {{max_chars}}; const truncated = text.length > MAX; if (truncated) text = text.slice(0, MAX); if (!text) throw new Error('web-read empty text — url=' + location.href + ' title=' + document.title + ' readyState=' + document.readyState); return { url: location.href, title: document.title, description: md ? md.content : null, canonical: can ? can.href : null, lang: document.documentElement.lang || null, chars: text.length, truncated: truncated, text: text }; })()

steps.note: 引擎本体就是 reader——这一步是「Jina Reader 平替」：goto+抽取，无第三方代理、无第三方读取我的浏览。容器优先级 article>main>[role=main]>body，clone 后剥 script/style/导航/页脚等噪声再取文本（clone 脱离布局树，innerText 退化为 textContent 语义——空白规整靠正则不做布局折叠，v1 取舍写进 flow.md）。截断 max_chars（默认 2 万字）防回执爆炸；全空就地 throw
